Fortune dragons have the innate ability to draw upon the raw magical energies that surround them. They constantly use these magical energies to empower their magical abilities and even their bodies, as the energy can heal wounds. A fortune dragon has a typical build for an arcane dragon, but their bodies sport a striking feature: their treasure. The dragon's nature of drawing upon magic causes coins, gems, and, most notably, magical items to cling to their body like iron drawn to magnets. A dragon constantly pulls magical energies from the items attached to their body and makes use of these energies to cast spells. The magical energies that flow through a fortune dragon constantly flow through the dragon's items as well, and in many cases, the items melt from the heat produced in this process. Fortune dragons are seekers of novel experiences. This desire for originality leads fortune dragons to approach visitors of other ancestries with curiosity, though this initial interest quickly wanes if a visitor lacks exciting qualities. **[Recall Knowledge - Dragon](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35)): DC 41 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 39 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 36 [Ancient Fortune Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2946) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 118 **Perception** +30; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109) **Skills** [Accounting Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +37, [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +36, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +37, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +34, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +37, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +32, [Mercantile Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +37, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +36 **Str** +9 **Dex** +9 **Con** +8 **Int** +10 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +5 --- **AC** 43 **Fort** +31 **Ref** +34 **Will** +32 +2 status to all saves vs. [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534) **HP** 300 **Immunities** [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) **Aura of Disruption** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542)) 120 feet. The dragon radiates disruptive energies that allow them to feed on magic. When a spell is [counteracted](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) or disrupted within the aura, the dragon regains one expended spontaneous spell slot and gains 35 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.
**Capture Spell** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534)) **Trigger** The dragon succeeds or critically succeeds on a saving throw against a spell; **Effect** The dragon attempts to capture a portion of the spell's magic to feed themself. They attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the spell (counteract rank 10, counteract modifier +37). If successful, the dragon is unaffected by the spell and regains one expended spontaneous spell slot; other subjects are affected by the spell normally. --- **Speed** 80 feet, fly 180 feet **Melee** jaws +34 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 4d10+15 piercing plus 1d6 force **Melee** claw +34 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 4d6+15 piercing plus 1d6 force **Melee** tail +32 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 4d10+15 bludgeoning plus 1d6 force **Arcane Spontaneous Spells** DC 45, attack +37 - **Cantrips (10th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246) - **10th** [Chain Lightning](/Spells.aspx?ID=33), [Fireball](/Spells.aspx?ID=119), [Force Barrage](/Spells.aspx?ID=1536), [Implosion](/Spells.aspx?ID=162), [Quandary](/Spells.aspx?ID=1644), [Slither](/Spells.aspx?ID=1676), [Unfettered Movement](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732), [Warp Mind](/Spells.aspx?ID=369) (3 slots) **Disruptive Breath** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) The dragon unleashes a spray of magic-disrupting energies that deals 18d6 force damage in a 60-foot cone (DC 45 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save) Creatures that fail become [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) (stupefied 2 on a critical failure) for 1 minute. The dragon can't use Disruptive Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Draconic Frenzy** The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order. **Draconic Momentum** Whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike, the dragon chooses to either recharge Disruptive Breath or regain one expended spontaneous spell slot. **Drain Hoard** **Requirements** The dragon is within 60 feet of their hoard; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The dragon draws power out of the magic items in their hoard, regaining all their expended spontaneous spell slots. **Share the Wealth** **Requirements** The dragon's body is covered in riches (this is typically the case when the dragon is first encountered); **Effect** The dragon shakes their body aggressively, sending coins and other riches flying in every direction, dealing 18d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 40 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save to all creatures in a 50-foot emanation. The dragon's body is then no longer covered in riches. **Treasure Dive** **Requirements** The dragon's body isn't covered in riches and the dragon is adjacent to their hoard; **Effect** The dragon Strides or [Burrows](/Actions.aspx?ID=2310) through their hoard using their land Speed. They coat themself in coins, magic items, and other treasures. This contact with magical items revitalizes the dragon, causing them to regain one expended spontaneous spell slot. The dragon can move through other creatures while moving in this way. Creatures in the dragon's path, or above it if the dragon Burrows, must succeed at a DC 38 Reflex save or be [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet (or pushed 20 feet and knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) on a critical failure).
